name: Hockenheimring
notes: Hockenheimring Grand Prix circuit since 2002 (clockwise). Same raceway loop as dtm-era4 hockenheim13: the members of OSM relation 284588 without the pit lanes. Traced 4517 m vs 4574 m. Start line from the middle of the pit lane. One DRS zone on the Parabolika to the hairpin as in 2012. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
